evals.prompt: 2026년 전기차 보조금 정책 조사해서 보고서로 만들어줘
evals.expected_output: 국내 2026년 전기차 구매 보조금 정책(국비/지자체 등)을 웹 조사해 조사개요/요약/상세결과(가능하면 표)/결론/유의사항 구조를 갖춘 .docx 보고서와 동일 내용의 .txt 파일을 생성한다.
expectations: A .docx file is saved to the outputs folder
A .txt file with matching content is saved to the outputs folder alongside the .docx
The docx title run uses 40pt font size
The docx Normal/body style default font size is 20pt
The document has a section covering the research scope/overview (조사 개요 or equivalent)
The document has a summary section (요약) stating the key conclusion up front
The document has a conclusion/recommendation section (결론 및 추천 or equivalent)
The document has a caveats/notes section (유의사항) mentioning the research date and that policy details may change
The report states a specific research/reference date consistent with 2026-08-06
The document includes a table comparing subsidy amounts (e.g. by region, vehicle type, or manufacturer) rather than only prose
The .txt file does not use markdown syntax like '##' or '**' for structure
